text:
67세 남성 환자, acute heart failure로 입원. Hypertensive emergency 확인됨.

Vital signs: BP 220/130 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min, BT 36.7°C, SpO2 90% (room air).

Chest pain severe 호소함.

Nitroglycerin 10 mcg/min IV TID 적용함.

High-flow nasal cannula 적용함.

C-line 유지함.

Positive fluid balance 확인됨.

Clinical status drowsy 확인됨.

Cardiology team notify함.
